reviews.title: طلب خاطئ، وتجاهل للشكاوى، واعتذار لا يحل شيئًا!
reviews.text:
من أسوأ تجاربي مع تطبيقات التوصيل. طلبت عبر هنقرستيشن، ووصلني طلب مختلف عن الذي طلبته! وعند التواصل معهم عبر التطبيق، لم أجد تجاوبًا فعليًا يعالج المشكلة؛ كل ما حصلت عليه هو: «نعتذر لسوء الخدمة». ثم بقيت مخاطباتي دون رد مفيد أو حل!

أنا دفعت مقابل طلب اخترته، ولم أدفع لأستلم طلبًا آخر ثم أضيّع وقتي في ملاحقة خدمة العملاء. الاعتذار ليس حلًا، وإغلاق المحادثة لا يعني انتهاء المشكلة!

نصيحتي لكل من يطلب: صوّروا الطلب فور استلامه، خصوصًا إذا كان خاطئًا أو ناقصًا، وصوّروا محتويات الكيس والفاتورة، واحتفظوا بالمحادثات. لا تتركوا غياب الصور يتحول إلى ذريعة لإغلاق الشكوى بدلًا من معالجتها؛ فالعميل لا يفترض أن يدخل في معركة إثبات حتى يحصل على الخدمة التي دفع مقابلها.

خدمة العملاء تُختبر عندما يحدث خطأ، وفي تجربتي أخفق هنقرستيشن في معالجة الخطأ والتواصل واحترام وقت العميل. تجربة محبطة أفقدتني الثقة بالتطبيق، ولا أنصح به بناءً على ما واجهته.

reviews.title: UNACCEPTABLE SERVICE & CONSUMER RIGHTS VIOLATION!
reviews.text:
UNACCEPTABLE SERVICE & CONSUMER RIGHTS VIOLATION!

I strongly advise everyone to avoid using Hungerstation. Due to an honest mistake with the location pin on a grocery order from Panda, I experienced the worst customer service possible.

First, support called me demanding an extra cash payment for the courier just to complete the delivery. When I refused this extortion, they pressured me into canceling the order. Within literally ONE MINUTE after cancellation, I contacted support and requested that my paid groceries be dropped off at my workplace where colleagues were ready to receive them. Hungerstation flatly refused to deliver my groceries AND refused to refund my money.

To make matters worse, their shift supervisor initially confirmed in writing that a full refund would be issued within 2–4 days. Later, another agent blatantly contradicted this, stating that 100% of my money was confiscated and no refund would ever be issued.

Keeping 100% of a customer's hard-earned money while providing ZERO goods is unlawful withholding of funds under Saudi Consumer Protection Law. I have saved all chat transcripts, order details, and screenshots and am submitting a formal report directly to the Ministry of Commerce (1900 / Balagh Tijari). Disgraceful and predatory behavior!

reviews.title: Worst customer service experience
reviews.text:
Absolutely unacceptable. I placed a pickup order that was promised to be ready by 6:20 PM, but after driving to the restaurant, I was repeatedly told to wait. After more than 15 minutes, they finally admitted they were missing an essential ingredient and had no idea when it would be ready. I didn’t receive my food until 6:55 PM, causing me to almost miss an important appointment.

What made this experience even worse was HungerStation’s customer service. I contacted them while it was happening, yet they refused to refund me if I canceled, even though the delay was entirely their fault. Their only response was, “We’ll pass your comments to the restaurant so it won’t happen again.” That’s not a solution.

How am I supposed to trust an app that takes no responsibility when things go wrong? If customers can’t get a refund for mistakes made by the restaurant or the platform, then what protection do we actually have? This was a complete waste of my time and money.

reviews.title: Bad experience of using app
reviews.text:
My Experience – Want a Tip?

A few friends recommended that I stop using this app, and after my own experiences, I understand why.

I have placed many orders through this app in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and unfortunately, my food has repeatedly been delivered very late. Despite this, the company still charges a delivery fee of around 11 SAR, plus a 2 SAR service fee, and sometimes additional charges depending on the order value.

I have contacted customer service many times through the in-app chat. On several occasions, I was told that if my order was delayed, I would receive 30 SAR compensation, but in my experience, this promise was not honoured. I found the responses inconsistent and very disappointing.

What frustrated me even more was that some customer service agents ended the chat before resolving my issue, leaving me without a proper solution.

After reading many other customer reviews, I realised I am not the only person who has experienced these problems. In my opinion, the service has not met the standard I expect from a delivery platform.

Because of my personal experience, I have decided to stop using this app. I have had much better experiences with Ninja and Jahez, and I personally find them more reliable.

If anyone would like to see screenshots of my conversations with customer service, I am happy to provide them as proof of my own experience.

Very disappointing. I hope the company improves its service and starts treating customers fairly.

reviews.title: Order Never Delivered, Refund Never Received
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with HungerStation. I placed an order worth 190 SAR, but the driver never arrived and I never received my order.

When I contacted HungerStation support, they claimed that a refund had been processed and provided me with a reference number. However, after checking with my bank multiple times, the bank confirmed that no refund was ever received. I communicated with both the bank and HungerStation support, but the issue remained unresolved.

After waiting nearly 20 days, HungerStation finally informed me that the order was non-refundable and simply closed the case. This is completely unacceptable customer service. As a foreigner and a tourist, this experience was extremely frustrating and disappointing.

I lost 190 SAR without receiving my order, and no proper solution was provided. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app to tourists or anyone looking for reliable food delivery service. Customer support needs significant improvement, especially when handling refund disputes.

reviews.title: Very Disappointing Handling of a Food Safety Complaint
reviews.text:
have been a loyal HungerStation customer for years and have never submitted a complaint like this before.

After ordering salads through the app, both my husband and I developed significant gastrointestinal symptoms, including abdominal cramps, diarrhea, and vomiting. I reported the issue immediately, contacted the restaurant directly, and contacted HungerStation multiple times.

What disappointed me most was not the cost of the order, but how the complaint was handled. I was initially informed that a refund would be processed, but later I was told that no action would be taken without a medical report. When I asked for clarification regarding the investigation, the policy being applied, and the change in decision, I did not receive clear answers.

As of today, we are still recovering and following a bland diet due to ongoing symptoms. I understand that companies must follow procedures, but I expected the incident to be documented, investigated, and handled transparently.

I hope HungerStation improves its process for handling food safety complaints and customer concerns in the future.

reviews.text: My experience with HungerStation was misleading and unacceptable. reviews.title: Refusal of Refund for Order
reviews.text:
I am writing to express my extreme frustration regarding the fraudulent behavior I have experienced with Hungerstation. My order was canceled, and I was initially provided with a Refund Reference Number, with a promise that the amount would be returned within a week.
However, after a week passed and no funds were received, I contacted support again, only to be told that I am "no longer eligible" for a refund because I supposedly did not respond to the driver. This is completely false. I provided the driver with all the necessary location details and even sent a photo of the exact delivery spot to ensure a smooth drop-off.
Providing a refund reference number and then retracting it is a clear act of deception and lack of professional integrity. I have proof of my communication with the driver and the initial refund confirmation.
I demand an immediate reversal of this decision and a full refund of my money. This is the worst service experience I have ever had, and I will not hesitate to escalate this matter to the Ministry of Commerce (Balagh) if it is not resolved promptly.

reviews.title: Refused to refund undelivered grocery items
reviews.text:
On April 07, 2026, I placed an order through HungerStation. One of the items in my order was unavailable, and I was prompted to choose between a refund or replacement. However, I did not select any option because I intended to cancel the entire order if that item was not available.

I immediately contacted customer service to request full cancellation. The agent informed me that the remaining items were already being prepared and that cancellation was no longer possible. Despite this, I clearly did not consent to proceed with a partial order.

Furthermore, the customer service agent explicitly advised me not to receive the order from the delivery driver and to inform the driver that it was the wrong order so that I would be eligible for a refund. It was also clearly stated during my conversation with the agent that I would receive a refund. I will be attaching a copy of our conversation as supporting evidence.

However, despite following the agent’s instructions and raising this concern via email, more than 48 hours have passed and I have not received any adequate response or resolution.

This situation is unjust, as I acted in good faith based on the instructions provided by HungerStation’s representative, yet no refund has been processed.
